fields.name: name
fields.label: Section Name
fields.description: The label shown for this section in the Content Tree

fields.name: background-mobile
fields.label: Background image (mobile)
fields.description: Falls back to the desktop image

fields.name: classes
fields.label: View (minimum cards: view 1 = 3, view 2 = 3, view 3 = 4, view 4 = 2)

fields.name: image
fields.label: Image (with images / black and white designs)

fields.name: anchor
fields.label: ID (anchor, optional)
fields.description: Used as the section id and the #link of the navigation. Generated when empty

fields.name: downloadAll
fields.label: Download all: ZIP file from DAM (with image view, optional)
fields.description: If empty, the 'Download all' button is hidden

fields.name: size
fields.label: File size (e.g. 1.2 MB, optional)
fields.description: Shown as '(EXT, size)' in the small view. The extension is taken from the URL

fields.name: text
fields.label: Content
fields.description: Documents: an optional heading (list title) followed by links to DAM files, one per paragraph or list item. Text written after a link is shown as its file size

fields.name: name
fields.label: Section Name
fields.description: The label shown for this section in the Content Tree

fields.name: style
fields.label: Header part
fields.description: Which part of the header this section feeds. Add 'Simple header' to any section to render the header-simple variant.

fields.name: media_image
fields.label: Image (desktop)
fields.description: Required. Cover image (first image of the group). In Home view with a video it is shown until the video plays.

fields.name: media_imageTablet
fields.label: Image (tablet crop, optional)
fields.description: Second image of the media group: always set the desktop image first.

fields.name: media_video
fields.label: Vimeo video URL (Home view)
fields.description: e.g. https://vimeo.com/123456789. Leave empty for an image background.

fields.name: text
fields.label: Content
fields.description: Section view: optional subheading paragraph, heading, text and one bold/italic link as button. Home view: heading only.

fields.name: ref
fields.label: Link of the "No" button
fields.description: Overridden by the page metadata modal-sanitary-redirect

fields.name: classes_bcorp
fields.label: Show B Corp logo (button view, page metadata bcorp-logo)

fields.name: text
fields.label: Content
fields.description: Button view: heading, text and one bold/italic link as button. Other views: text only.
